resolutions.researcher_notes: Original dead current_ref was an archive.org screenshot item (no longer resolvable). Replaced with two independent tracks supporting 'construction': (1) Guangxi DRC (发改委) project-approval notice 桂发改能源（2022）59号, dated 2022-04-11 -- original fgw.gxzf.gov.cn is geo-blocked (ConnectTimeout) but its Wayback snapshot (2025-05-23 capture) is live and readable, formally authorizing construction of 桂东南环网梧州—岑溪段天然气管道项目; (2) Wuzhou-municipal-government-sourced construction-progress news (news.qq.com, 2024-11-18, credited to 梧州发布) reporting the project 90% complete with process/electrical/instrumentation work underway and full completion targeted end-Dec-2024 -- i.e. still under active construction, not yet operating, consistent with recorded Status=construction. The two tracks are genuinely independent (regulator approval doc vs. municipal media); a same-day finance.sina.com.cn republication of the same news story exists but is NOT counted as independent of news.qq.com (both trace to 梧州发布) and is itself dead with no Wayback snapshot, so it was not cited.

Both independent sources explicitly describe this as a 天然气管道 (natural gas pipeline) project -- the Guangxi DRC approval notice title itself is '...天然气管道项目核准的批复', and the news.qq.com construction-progress article likewise refers to it throughout as a natural-gas pipeline. Confirms Fuel=Gas.

Original current_ref (gas.in-en.com/html/gas-2834095.shtml) is dead with NO Wayback snapshot (checked via archive.org availability API and CDX search -- empty on both). Extensive fresh Chinese-language search (site queries combining 桂东南环网 / 梧州—岑溪段 / 天然气管道 with 2018年5月 / 立项 / 建议书 / 核准) turned up no article or notice dated 2018-05 for this specific segment. The only dated official document found for this segment is the Guangxi DRC's formal PROJECT approval (桂发改能源（2022）59号), dated 2022-04-11 -- a different date and a different administrative stage (final core-approval, not an early proposal/建议书) than the recorded ProposalYear=2018/ProposalMonth=5. Since what was found does not match the recorded value, per standing instructions this is left UNRESOLVED rather than substituting a ref for a different date; flagging the 2018-05 vs 2022-04 discrepancy for review rather than silently fixing it.

EXACT match on both independent sources. Guangxi DRC approval notice: '设计输量 5.9×10^8 m3/a 立方米/年' = 0.59 bcm/y. News.qq.com construction-progress article: '年输气能力将达5.9亿立方米' = 0.59 bcm/y annual transmission capacity once complete. Both exactly match recorded Capacity=0.59, CapacityUnits=bcm/y.

Original current_ref was the live URL of this exact document (dead at its origin -- fgw.gxzf.gov.cn is geo-blocked, ConnectTimeout); recovered via its Wayback snapshot (2025-05-23 capture), which passes url_verifier. Document states '设计压力 6.3MPa 兆帕' -- EXACT match to recorded Pressure=6.30, PressureUnits=MPa. No second independent source with pipe-spec detail was found despite searching, so left at medium/single-source (the source itself is a primary regulatory approval document, high authority, but only one origin).

NOTE: news.qq.com (2024-11-18) separately gives a slightly different total of 59km (with a 29.5km Cenxi-city portion); treated as design-vs-as-built rounding (~1.7% delta), not a disagreement, but NOT cited here as a second ref for this specific cell since it doesn't exactly match the recorded 60.00 value -- only the exact-match fgw approval doc is proposed.

Recovered via Wayback snapshot of the same dead current_ref. Document states '管径 D406.4mm 毫米, 管材钢级 L360' -- EXACT match to recorded Diameter=406.40, DiameterUnits=mm. No second independent source with this level of pipe-spec detail found.

No current_ref to start from. Searched extensively (Chinese-language: 桂东南环网 气源 / 中缅管道 桂东南环网 / 西东气二线 桂东南) for any source connecting the Wuzhou-Cenxi/Longwei segment specifically to the Sino-Myanmar Gas Pipeline as its upstream feed; found none. Neither the Guangxi DRC approval document nor the news.qq.com construction-progress article names an upstream gas source. This SE-Guangxi corridor (Wuzhou/Cenxi, near the Guangdong border) sits geographically on the opposite side of the province from the Sino-Myanmar pipeline's Yunnan entry point, and is at least as plausible to draw from the West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2 Guangzhou-Nanning extension (cited elsewhere on the same GEM wiki page) -- a genuine open attribution question, left unfilled rather than fabricate a ref, consistent with the prior deep-sweep audit's finding on this same point.

Guangxi DRC approval doc gives full route detail matching every recorded field EXACTLY: start '梧州市龙圩区大坡镇的广南支干线梧州压气站' (Dapo Town, Longwei District, Wuzhou) and end '岑溪市大业镇思回村的岑溪分输站' (Sihui Village, Daye Town, Cenxi City) -- matching StartLocation/StartPrefecture-District/EndLocation/EndPrefecture-District exactly, including the village-level EndLocation detail. News.qq.com independently corroborates the town/district/city level of both endpoints (Dapo Town/Longwei District start; Daye Town/Cenxi City end) though it does not mention the village name. Treated as two independent sources for the primary value (StartLocation='Dapo Town, Longwei District').

Recovered via Wayback snapshot of the same dead current_ref. Document states '本项目总投资为 29916 万元' (total investment 299.16 million RMB) in TWO places (main approval body and the attached 招标事项核准意见) -- EXACT match to recorded SegmentCost=299,160,000.00 RMB. No second independent source with this cost figure found.

This resolves the prior deep-sweep audit's open question (it flagged Operator/QCCOwner attribution to this specific segment as unconfirmed).
